subject: general
question: Seven people, A, B, C, T, U, V and W are sitting in a row, facing north. Only three people sit to the left of V. Only A sits to the right of U. Only three people sit between U and W. T sits at some place to the left of B but at some place to the right of C. How many people sit between C and B?
solution:
Given: Seven people, A, B, C, T, U, V and W are sitting in a row, facing north.

 
• Only three people sit to the left of V.
 
• Only A sits to the right of U.
 
• Only three people sit between U and W.
 
• T sits at some place to the left of B but at some place to the right of C

The Final Arrangement is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9463ffca71bc540041c791903a3dfafa3cda8ca2d2e5d548fbb0a07c2376fd99.png] 

Three people sit between C and B.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
